CustomField.inlineHelpText: How much of the daily allowance was gone at the moment of the attempt. When replies stop arriving, look here first.
CustomField.label: Txn Emails Used
CustomField.description: Emails sent in THIS transaction, from Limits.getEmailInvocations(). Apex cannot read the org daily cap; that is only visible from the REST limits endpoint as SingleEmail. Do not read this as a daily figure.
